note: Battle music for RP events (the owner's files, 30 Sep 2026). source = the owner's download it is cut from; file = what scripts/build-battle-music.js writes to client/audio/events/. Wild legendaries play their own theme instead (data/legend-music.json). loop "repeat": the track has an intro that plays once, and the loop goes back to where the song repeats (found by the build script).

wild.source: Pokémon Black & White - Wild Pokemon Battle Music (HQ) - Pokeli.mp3

rarewild.source: Pokémon Black & White - Rare Wild Pokemon Battle Music (HQ) - Pokeli.mp3
rarewild.plays: a wild Pokemon that is shiny, or rare or better on the rarity ladder (rare, starter, pseudo, Ultra Beast, paradox, or a legendary with no theme of its own)

trainer.source: Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald - Trainer Battle Music (HQ) - Pokeli.mp3
trainer.plays: an NPC trainer (a rolled route trainer or a story trainer below gym level)

gym.source: Pokémon Diamond, Pearl & Platinum - Gym Leader Battle Music (HQ) - Pokeli.mp3

elitefour.source: Pokémon Diamond, Pearl & Platinum - Elite Four Battle Music (HQ) - Pokeli.mp3

champion.source: Champion Cynthia Intro and Battle Theme - Under Average Gaming.mp3
champion.plays: the Champion (the piano intro plays once, then the battle part loops)

shiny.source: (HD) Pokémon Generation 3 Shiny Sparkles Green Screen_Blue Screen + Shiny Sound Effect - NotJFlash.mp3
shiny.plays: a shiny Pokemon sent out, in any battle or replay
